rfp_requirements.title: Provide Subcontractor Business Registration
rfp_requirements.description: Each named subcontractor shall provide a copy of its business registration to the Contractor, who shall provide it to the State.

rfp_requirements.title: Collect and Remit Use Tax
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor, any subcontractor, and each of their affiliates shall, during the term of the contract, collect and remit to the Director of the Division of Taxation the Use Tax due on all sales of tangible personal property delivered into the State.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe secure coding training for developers
rfp_requirements.description: As applicable, describe the training provided to developers with respect to secure coding practices and system development life cycle.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide deployment plan for key personnel during mobilization
rfp_requirements.description: The Mobilization Plan shall include the Bidder's plan for deployment and use of management, supervisory, or other key personnel during the mobilization period, identifying any personnel assigned only during mobilization.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide staff recruitment plan including backup staffing
rfp_requirements.description: The Mobilization Plan shall include the Bidder's plan for recruitment of staff required on the Contract start date, including a plan to secure backup staff in the event personnel need assistance or replacement.

rfp_requirements.title: Use only domestic materials on public works contracts
rfp_requirements.description: If the contract is for construction, alteration, or repair of any public work, the contractor and all subcontractors shall use only domestic materials unless otherwise noted in the specifications.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe past five-year information security breaches
rfp_requirements.description: Describe in detail any breaches of information security the organization experienced over the past five years, including how affected customers were notified, the timeframe of notifications, and steps taken to prevent recurrence.

rfp_requirements.title: Make all personnel/backup staff available
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor shall make all personnel and backup staff available to the State at all various labor categories specified within this Bid Solicitation.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Employee Training and Certification
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide Employee Training and Certification.

rfp_requirements.title: Training topic: air pollution problems and causes/effects
rfp_requirements.description: Training must impart knowledge of air pollution problems and its causes and effects.

rfp_requirements.title: Training topic: quality control procedures and purpose
rfp_requirements.description: Training must impart knowledge of quality control procedures and purpose.

rfp_requirements.title: Training topic: public relations
rfp_requirements.description: Training must impart knowledge of public relations.

rfp_requirements.title: Obtain SCM written approval of training materials
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor must secure SCM written approval for all training materials intended for use by the Contractor prior to activation of its initial training.

rfp_requirements.title: Offer employment first to covered CBA employees
rfp_requirements.description: Consistent with P.L. 2025, c.359, any employee of the current vendor covered by a collective bargaining agreement shall be the first to be offered employment to meet staffing needs of the Contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain Staffing Roster
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must maintain a staffing roster.

rfp_requirements.title: Include Min/Max staffing plan
rfp_requirements.description: The CIF Staffing/Training Plan shall include an adequate Min/Max staffing plan for all trained and licensed personnel during all typical periods throughout the workday, week, and month.

rfp_requirements.title: Inspectors must wear SCM-approved uniforms
rfp_requirements.description: All inspectors must wear uniforms provided by the Contractor and approved by the SCM.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe security awareness training program
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must describe the security awareness and training program provided to personnel and contractors, indicate whether training is mandatory, how it is documented and tracked, and how often it is conducted.

rfp_requirements.title: List intended user roles and privileges
Escalate unaddressed alerts to State staff per SLA
Address staffing, skills, cross training
Indicate participant training requirements
Detail recovery priorities, procedures, timelines
Provide and complete all authorized end-user training
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must have provided and successfully completed all authorized end-user training requirements on the use of the system (text cut off at window end but represents a Final System Acceptance criterion).

rfp_requirements.title: Complete authorized end-user training on Management Console and audit functions
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide and successfully complete all authorized end-user training requirements on the use of the Management Console and audit functions (carried over from Section 4.28 completion criteria at top of page 82).

rfp_requirements.title: Optional additional information - Security Awareness and Training
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder may optionally provide any additional information relative to the Security Awareness and Training (AW) control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Hold QA Program review meetings every 90 Calendar Days
rfp_requirements.description: During the Operations Phase, the QA Manager and appropriate staff must hold meetings with the SCM every 90 Calendar Days to review QA Program status.

rfp_requirements.title: Require written SCM approval for ITS system access
rfp_requirements.description: System access for Contractor staff and support personnel must be requested in writing based on an identified business need and require written SCM approval prior to granting access.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide start-up assistance and secure training for new PIF/PFF inspectors
rfp_requirements.description: Provide start-up assistance to new PIFs/PFFs entering the program and assist in securing training for new inspectors from authorized training providers.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit Resumes for Substitute Personnel
rfp_requirements.description: Resumes must be submitted for individual(s) proposed as substitutes, who must have qualifications and experience equal to or better than those originally proposed or currently assigned.

rfp_requirements.title: Resume work upon date specified in stop order
Implement personnel security processes
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must implement processes ensuring all personnel with access to State information have appropriate background, skills, and training.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide monthly and cumulative SBE/MBE/WBE subcontractor payment breakdown
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide on a monthly and cumulative basis a breakdown of all monies paid to small business, minority, or woman-owned subcontractors, sent to the Office of Diversity and Inclusion.

rfp_requirements.title: Sole responsibility for subcontractor payments
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor has sole responsibility for all payments due any Subcontractor.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide periodic security awareness and training
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide periodic and ongoing information security awareness and training to personnel.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide security training upon hire and annually
rfp_requirements.description: Personnel must be provided with security awareness training upon hire and at least annually thereafter.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain security awareness training records
rfp_requirements.description: Security awareness training records must be maintained as part of the personnel record.

rfp_requirements.title: Recreate lost State Data due to Contractor fault
rfp_requirements.description: In the event of loss of State Data due to intentional act, omission, or negligence of Contractor/subcontractor/agent, Contractor is responsible for recreating lost data per schedule set by State Contract Manager.

rfp_requirements.title: Train users on remote access security
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must train users regarding information security risks and best practices related to remote access use.

rfp_requirements.title: Applicant Must Refrain from Contracting with Debarred Contractors
rfp_requirements.description: The applicant agrees it will refrain from entering into any contract or contract modification subject to Executive Order 11246 with a Contractor debarred from, or who has not demonstrated eligibility for, Government contracts and federally assisted construction contracts, and will carry out sanction

rfp_requirements.title: Insert Copeland Clauses in Subcontracts
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor or subcontractor shall insert in any subcontracts the Copeland clause and such other clauses as FEMA may require, plus a clause requiring subcontractors to include these clauses in lower tier subcontracts; the prime Contractor is responsible for subcontractor compliance.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay Overtime for Hours Over 40 per Workweek
rfp_requirements.description: No Contractor or subcontractor shall require or permit any laborer or mechanic to work in excess of forty hours in a workweek unless the laborer or mechanic receives compensation at a rate not less than one and one-half times the basic rate of pay for all hours in excess of forty.

rfp_requirements.title: Insert CWHSSA Clauses in Subcontracts
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor or subcontractor shall insert the clauses set forth in paragraphs (b)(1) through (4) in any subcontracts, and include a clause requiring subcontractors to include these clauses in lower tier subcontracts; the prime Contractor is responsible for compliance.

rfp_requirements.title: Enforce non-disclosure and separation of duties
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must enforce separation of job duties, require commercially reasonable non-disclosure agreements, and limit staff knowledge of State Data to what is absolutely needed.

rfp_requirements.title: Conduct criminal background checks on staff
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must conduct criminal background checks and not utilize any staff, including subcontractors, who has been convicted of any crime of dishonesty (including criminal fraud), any felony, or any misdemeanor with up to 1 year incarceration as authorized penalty.

rfp_requirements.title: Excluded classifications from recognition
rfp_requirements.description: Specifically excluded from recognition are office clerical employees, confidential employees, supervisors and guards, as defined by the Act.

rfp_requirements.title: Definition of Union membership for Article purposes
rfp_requirements.description: For purposes of Article II, an Employee shall be considered a member of the Union if he/she tenders his/her periodic dues uniformly required as a condition of membership.

rfp_requirements.title: Resume dues deductions upon return from absence
rfp_requirements.description: Upon return of an Employee to work from termination/transfer/layoff/leave absences, the Employer will immediately resume deductions; absences of 6 months or more require a new authorization.

rfp_requirements.title: Probationary period of 90 days after 2 weeks training
rfp_requirements.description: Newly hired Employees shall be considered probationary for 90 days following the completion of 2 weeks of training; such Employees may be discharged at will and periods of unpaid leave do not count toward probation.

rfp_requirements.title: Make work schedules 30 days in advance
rfp_requirements.description: All work schedules (except lunch and daily breaks) must be made 30 days in advance; schedules may be adjusted for training with two weeks notice.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay annual uniform maintenance allowance
rfp_requirements.description: By the second pay period each year, Employer shall pay $500 uniform maintenance allowance to each Equipment Repair Technician and Technical Specialist, and $300 to each Material Handler Associate, Material Handler, Material Handler Senior, and Material Handler Specialist.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide uniforms to Material Handlers/ERT/Technical Specialists
rfp_requirements.description: Employer shall provide each Employee 5 new uniforms (5 trousers, 5 shirts) and 1 baseball hat upon hiring and annually thereafter.

rfp_requirements.title: Launder Lane Technician uniforms weekly
rfp_requirements.description: Employer will pick up, launder, and drop off five sets of uniforms (5 trousers, 5 shirts) per Employee weekly.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Lane Technician uniforms and annual items
rfp_requirements.description: Employer shall provide each new Lane Technician 11 new uniforms (11 trousers, 11 shirts); every Employee issued one new summer hat, one new winter hat, and one new pair of gloves annually.

rfp_requirements.title: Refer uniform/laundry questions to Labor Management Committee
rfp_requirements.description: The components of the uniform supplied by the Employer and any questions concerning the laundry service may be addressed to the Labor Management Committee established in Article XXXIX.

rfp_requirements.title: Inform recruitment agencies of nondiscrimination policy
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must inform in writing its recruitment agencies (employment agencies, placement bureaus, colleges, universities, labor unions) that it does not discriminate and will discontinue use of any agency engaging in discriminatory practices.

rfp_requirements.title: Review transfer/upgrading/downgrading/layoff procedures for nondiscrimination
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must review all procedures relating to transfer, upgrading, downgrading and layoff to ensure all such actions are taken without regard to protected classes.

rfp_requirements.title: Non-discrimination during performance of construction contract
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor/subcontractor shall not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment based on protected classes during performance of construction contracts.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with Treasurer regulations and ADA (construction)
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must comply with any regulations promulgated by the Treasurer pursuant to N.J.S.A. 10:5-31 et seq. and the Americans with Disabilities Act.

rfp_requirements.title: Take immediate action if union not referring minority/women workers
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must take immediate action to provide direct EEO opportunities if it determines the union is not referring minority and women workers consistent with EEO goals.

rfp_requirements.title: Request union referrals of minority/women workers prior to commencement
rfp_requirements.description: Prior to commencement of work, contractor must request that the local construction trade union refer minority and women workers to fill job openings, if a referral agreement exists.

rfp_requirements.title: Leave standing referral requests with union and approved sources
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must leave standing requests for additional referrals of minority and women workers with the local construction trade union, State Training and Employment Service, and other approved referral sources in the area.

rfp_requirements.title: Interview referred minority or women workers
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor or subcontractor must interview the referred minority or women worker.

rfp_requirements.title: Determine qualifications and hire/schedule qualified minority/women workers
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must in good faith determine qualifications of referred individuals and hire/schedule those who meet qualification standards consistent with EEO principles, including trainees if necessary.

rfp_requirements.title: Employ minority/women workers residing within union geographic jurisdiction
rfp_requirements.description: When implementing procedures in (B), contractor must, where applicable, employ minority and women workers residing within the geographical jurisdiction of the union.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with union hiring hall / apprenticeship policies and exception for discriminatory practices
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor may comply with union hiring hall or apprenticeship policies in applicable CBAs, sending journeymen and trainees for referral/admission per such arrangement. However, where such practices result in the exclusion of minorities and women, contractor must consider persons referred pursuant t

rfp_requirements.title: Senior or Lane Technician Required in Two-Inspector Lane
rfp_requirements.description: If the Employer staffs a lane with two inspectors after breaks, one must be a Senior Lane Technician or a Lane Technician.

rfp_requirements.title: Eligibility for training grant for terminated MVC employees declining contractor offer
rfp_requirements.description: A person whose MVC employment is terminated due to a contract under subsection a., who does not accept an offer of employment with a contractor under paragraph (7), and who undergoes counseling pursuant to section 7 of P.L.1992, c.43, shall be eligible for a training grant under section 6 of P.L.199

rfp_requirements.title: Workforce Development Program may provide training grant
rfp_requirements.description: Notwithstanding any provision of P.L.1992, c.43 to the contrary, the Workforce Development Program in the Department of Labor and Workforce Development may provide a training grant to each qualifying applicant under paragraph (1) for employment and training services pursuant to section 6 of P.L.1992

rfp_requirements.title: List all countries where services performed outside U.S.
rfp_requirements.description: Where services will be performed outside the United States, Vendor must list every country where services will be performed by the Contractor and all Subcontractors.

rfp_requirements.title: Document good faith effort if subcontracting set-aside goals not met
rfp_requirements.description: If the Bid Solicitation has subcontracting set-aside goals and the Vendor has not achieved the goals, Vendor must attach information documenting its good faith effort to achieve the goals.

rfp_requirements.title: File Step 1 Grievance Within 15 Calendar Days
rfp_requirements.description: Within 15 calendar days of when facts giving rise to a grievance are known or should have been known, the Employee shall take it up through the Union representative with the immediate supervisor.

rfp_requirements.title: Complete Standard Contractual Grievance Form
rfp_requirements.description: If no resolution is reached, a standard contractual grievance form shall be completed by the aggrieved Employee and submitted to the immediate supervisor.
